---
title: "Pre-Course Assessment"
---

Before Day 1, take a short knowledge check — multiple choice, about 10
minutes, covering the fundamentals this course builds on (series
structure, basic statistics, a little Python/pandas). It helps calibrate
where the cohort is starting from so the pace can be set correctly.

It is **not** graded and has no bearing on your capstone result.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Link goes live per cohort.** The trainer shares the Google Form link for
your specific cohort at the start of Day 1 — there's no single standing
link here, since a new cohort gets a fresh form.
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Answer honestly — "I don't know yet" is useful information here, not a
wrong answer. The point is to find out what to spend more time on, not to
score anyone.
:::
